modules.title: 编码智能体 · 产品能力
modules.description: 从输入、配置和工具，到会话管理与终端工作流。

modules.title: Agent · 消息与工具执行
modules.description: 内存消息、多轮工具循环、工具前后 Hook、排队与取消。

modules.title: AI · 模型与提供商
modules.description: 统一消息、流式请求、认证、模型目录与协议适配。

modules.title: Codemode · 脚本沙箱
modules.description: QuickJS/WASM 中的模型脚本、工具桥接、输出与容量限制。

modules.title: MCP · 协议客户端与认证
modules.description: MCP 客户端、stdio/HTTP 传输、OAuth、内容与测试传输。

modules.title: Durable · 持久任务与文档
modules.description: 提交优先的会话、任务、模型生成、子智能体与存储。

modules.title: Env · 远程执行环境
modules.description: 通过 SSH 与远端 Rust daemon 执行文件和进程操作，Durable 与凭据留在本机。

modules.title: TUI · 终端界面
modules.description: 渲染、布局、编辑、补全、键鼠输入和终端能力。

modules.title: 原生集成 · 平台能力
modules.description: Windows、macOS、Linux 原生剪贴板与平台适配。

modules.title: Chord · 对象与热重载
modules.description: 契约、对象句柄、可观察状态、跨进程连接与热重载。

modules.title: Telemetry · 遥测契约
modules.description: 显式上下文、span、类型化事件和参考实现。

modules.title: 示例 · 扩展与 SDK
modules.description: 可阅读、可改写的扩展、SDK 和插件示例；不等于默认启用。

modules.title: 示例 · Agent + MCP + Codemode
modules.description: 展示在低层 Agent 中接入 MCP 工具与脚本编排。

modules.title: 示例 · Durable 能力演练
modules.description: 覆盖队列、恢复、子任务、前后台子会话与扩展配置的可运行示例。

modules.title: Evals · 行为评测
modules.description: 隔离评测、实验分组、重复运行和结果配对。

modules.title: 工程 · 构建与维护
modules.description: 依赖校验、构建发布、模型目录生成和开发统计。

features.title: CLI 启动与模式分派
features.purpose: 解析命令行并创建与当前目录绑定的会话，选择交互、print、JSON 或 RPC。
features.behavior: 启动装配设置、资源与模型运行时；实际模型循环由 Agent 执行。

features.title: 分层设置与配置值解析
features.purpose: 解析用户与项目设置，并提供跨安装形态的资源路径。
features.behavior: 配置作用域和优先级以 settings/configuration 文档为准。

features.title: 项目资源信任决策
features.purpose: 决定是否加载受信任控制的项目配置与可执行资源。
features.behavior: 项目资源信任不是文件系统、网络或进程级通用沙箱。

features.title: Pi 包安装、移除与资源配置
features.purpose: 组织 npm、git 和本地资源包的安装、更新与发现。
features.behavior: 区分 Pi 自身更新、扩展包更新与模型目录更新。

features.title: 资源发现、来源与冲突诊断
features.purpose: 统一发现扩展、技能、模板、主题与项目上下文文件。
features.behavior: 记录来源并处理碰撞；项目资源需遵守信任加载顺序。

features.title: 内置扩展装配与替换
features.purpose: CLI 把 llama.cpp、codemode、tool-search、MCP 作为内置扩展装配；同名用户扩展可替换可替换项。
features.behavior: SDK 默认不加载内置扩展；宿主需要显式加入对应工厂。

features.title: 扩展发现、注册与事件分发
features.purpose: 加载 TS/JS 扩展，注册工具、命令、快捷键、提供商与事件。
features.behavior: 工厂负责注册，runner 提供上下文与分发；原始类型注释可在 API 清单中逐项阅读。

features.title: MCP 分层配置与服务器注册
features.purpose: 合并用户 mcp.json、已信任项目配置与扩展注册，验证服务器及单工具暴露设置。
features.behavior: 同名文件配置优先于扩展；项目仅覆盖开关或暴露时保留用户端连接配置。项目来源受信任控制。

features.title: MCP OAuth 登录与提供商凭据转接
features.purpose: 管理服务器 OAuth 凭据、回调与增量授权；HTTP 服务器也可采用已登录提供商的 token。
features.behavior: 凭据按服务器名和 URL 隔离；项目配置不可使用 auth.provider；配置元数据 URL 与 clientRegistration 影响授权流程。

features.title: MCP 管理命令、UI 与日志
features.purpose: 添加、移除、检查、登录服务器，在交互会话中显示状态、工具与配置来源，并记录服务日志。
features.behavior: login 的 --timeout 限制整个登录流程；Shell 命令不加载扩展；已连接工具暴露和开关可按所属配置文件保存。

features.title: MCP 后台连接、等待与重连
features.purpose: 会话启动时后台连接服务器，按需等待、更新工具目录，并在断连后下一次调用重连。
features.behavior: 首个 prompt 只为 direct 服务器等待；调用工具不会因临时错误盲目重试，资源读取可重试；连接时不再预先枚举资源，由显式列表请求获取。

features.title: MCP 工具命名、暴露与结果适配
features.purpose: 把服务器工具接入 Pi 工具管线，规范化名称，传递 structuredContent、isError 和安全提示。
features.behavior: 规范化后的重名工具带 hash 后缀；模型端大文本截断并保留完整临时文件，脚本可收到完整结果。

features.title: MCP 资源、URI 模板与二进制读取
features.purpose: 注册资源列表、模板列表和读取工具，统一输出文本、图像或二进制临时文件路径。
features.behavior: 仅面向启用且非 hidden 的资源服务器；当前不渲染 MCP Apps 的 ui:// 与 HTML 资源。

features.title: 技能发现与按需说明
features.purpose: 发现技能元数据，把需要的完整说明提供给模型。
features.behavior: 技能主要是说明和资源；可执行扩展是另一种机制。

features.title: 提示模板与参数展开
features.purpose: 复用提示词文件并展开输入参数。
features.behavior: 发生在模型请求组装之前；与系统提示配置分别管理。

features.title: 认证存储、检查与凭据解析
features.purpose: 存储/解析认证信息，并提供凭据有效性检查。
features.behavior: 打印凭据的命令会写秘密到 stdout；此导览只索引实现，不读取用户凭据。

features.title: 模型选择、目录与提供商组合
features.purpose: 汇总可用模型、解析选择模式，并通过运行时派发请求。
features.behavior: 目录元数据不等同于可调用性；认证与具体提供商能力仍需满足。

features.title: 虚拟模型与请求路由
features.purpose: 允许选择逻辑模型，并将每次请求路由到物理模型。
features.behavior: 虚拟模型不会直接到达提供商；路由状态可跟随会话分支保存。

features.title: llama.cpp 路由器集成
features.purpose: 发现并管理本地模型路由器中的模型。
features.behavior: 与兼容 API 的 models.json 配置路径区分。

features.title: SDK 创建与替换运行时
features.purpose: 让应用在进程内创建、继续或替换编码智能体会话。
features.behavior: SDK 注入流函数、配置、工具与存储；运行时负责会话替换和重新绑定。

features.title: 会话保存、恢复与命名
features.purpose: 保存树形会话记录，并按项目、路径或 ID 恢复。
features.behavior: 当前分支重建下一次模型上下文，内存会话可关闭持久化。

features.title: 系统提示与上下文组装
features.purpose: 把工具、技能、项目说明与对话消息组织成请求内容。
features.behavior: 扩展可变换上下文；模型投影与持久化消息并非完全相同。

features.title: 文件附件、图片与管道输入
features.purpose: 将 @文件、图片和标准输入转成首条用户消息的内容。
features.behavior: 读取与规范化输入后组装消息；RPC 不接受 CLI 的 @file 参数。

features.title: 交互聊天与终端工作流
features.purpose: 接收用户交互并呈现模型消息、工具输出与运行状态。
features.behavior: UI 订阅会话事件；不把 UI 控制逻辑等同于模型执行循环。

features.title: 全屏终端、普通模式与启动显示
features.purpose: 默认全屏呈现聊天，提供 regular 模式保留终端滚动历史，支持安静启动时只显示 header。
features.behavior: fullscreen/regular 是终端呈现选择，不改变底层 Agent 消息循环。

features.title: 一次性文本与 JSON 事件输出
features.purpose: 适配脚本与管道：输出最终文本，或逐条输出 JSONL 事件。
features.behavior: 提交输入，等待会话处理并清理；标准输出背压与协议输出单独处理。

features.title: CLI RPC 与扩展 UI 代理
features.purpose: 让外部程序通过标准输入输出控制会话，并处理支持的扩展交互。
features.behavior: 通过 stdin/stdout 交换 JSONL 命令、响应与事件；外部程序管理进程与协议交互。

features.title: 快捷键与斜杠命令
features.purpose: 集中定义可配置动作与内置命令清单。
features.behavior: 快捷键应复用命名配置；完整命令表在参考文档内。

features.title: 剪贴板与外部编辑器
features.purpose: 支持复制消息、接收剪贴板图片及外部编辑工作流。
features.behavior: 能力取决于操作系统与终端环境。

features.title: 输入处理、排队与任务收尾
features.purpose: 协调扩展命令、输入转换、steering/follow-up、重试与最终通知。
features.behavior: agent_end 后仍可能继续；agent_settled 是完成自动处理后的通知边界。

features.title: 用户与自定义消息的统一运行准备
features.purpose: 用户输入和触发运行的自定义消息统一经过 _startRun、_prepareRun 与 before_agent_start。
features.behavior: 先标记忙碌，再检查压缩、执行扩展、准备工具与系统提示；事件的 messageType 区分 user 和 custom。

features.title: 工具暴露、命名空间与请求 Loadout
features.purpose: 把工具注册、激活、模型声明和脚本可调用性分开管理，扩展可为每次请求准备工具集。
features.behavior: 模型声明不代表所有注册工具；annotations、outputSchema 与 structuredContent 承载额外契约。

features.title: tool_search：BM25 搜索与延迟工具加载
features.purpose: 按名称、描述、参数与命名空间检索未声明工具，激活匹配项供下一次模型请求直接调用。
features.behavior: tool_search 改变工具集合并写入会话；脚本 searchTools 只查找可调用工具，两者职责不同。

features.title: codemode：脚本编排与并行工具
features.purpose: 让模型用 JavaScript 编排工具、并行调用与过滤大结果，仅把脚本输出送回模型。
features.behavior: on 保留直接工具，only 调整模型可见工具；QuickJS 没有文件、网络、Node 或 timer 能力，外部操作通过注入工具。

features.title: codemode 跨调用状态与分支恢复
features.purpose: 成功脚本把 store/load 修改保存为 codemode-store 条目，在继续、分叉和切换分支后恢复各自状态。
features.behavior: 失败脚本不提交 store 写入；工具已经造成的外部效果不会因此回滚，存储有值大小和总量限制。

features.title: 脚本分类模型、图像模型与用量
features.purpose: 向脚本暴露分类与图像模型目录及执行接口，沿会话凭据调用，并汇总用量。
features.behavior: 脚本不能执行对话模型；每脚本最多同时运行四个此类模型调用，需检查返回的 stopReason。

features.title: 脚本图像落盘与完整输出文件
features.purpose: 保存 image() 的图像和被截断的完整文本，让后续工具能用真实文件路径处理结果。
features.behavior: 图像只接受支持格式的 base64 数据，不把远程 URL 当作图像数据；临时文件生命周期由输出文件实现管理。

features.title: 嵌套工具管线、父子事件与用量记录
features.purpose: ctx.executeTool 将脚本发起的子调用交给同一校验、拦截和结果管线，汇总到父工具。
features.behavior: 子调用收到取消信号，串行策略由队列处理；嵌套结果不逐条进入模型上下文，记录有界。

features.title: read：读取文本与图片
features.purpose: 读取指定文件，把文本或支持的图像作为工具结果给模型。
features.behavior: 路径处理、输出限制与图片处理决定返回内容；可注入读取操作。

features.title: grep：内容检索
features.purpose: 搜索文件内容并返回匹配位置。
features.behavior: rg 的 cwd 设为搜索目录或目标文件父目录，相对 glob 基于搜索根匹配；输出上限与上下文行数仍受工具参数限制。

features.title: find：文件路径搜索
features.purpose: 通过路径模式查找文件。
features.behavior: 适合先定位路径，再调用 read；不同于 grep 的文件内容检索。

features.title: ls：目录枚举
features.purpose: 列出目录条目，帮助模型了解文件结构。
features.behavior: 仅列目录不读取全部文件内容。

features.title: edit：精确替换与差异展示
features.purpose: 定位旧文本并应用新文本，生成差异信息供展示。
features.behavior: 文件修改串行化；computeDiff 可注入异步展示差异计算。先写文件再算差异，diff 失败不表示修改回滚。

features.title: write：创建或覆写文件
features.purpose: 把模型给定内容写入目标文件。
features.behavior: 与 edit 的精确替换不同，write 可覆写内容；查看文件修改队列边界。

features.title: bash：Shell 执行与输出
features.purpose: 执行 shell 命令并将输出、退出状态和截断信息传回模型。
features.entry: 默认启用工具 bash；用户 ! 命令
features.behavior: 信号、超时、子进程与输出捕获由执行层协作处理。

features.title: powershell：Windows 命令执行
features.purpose: 为 Windows 提供 PowerShell 工具定义与可注入的操作。
features.behavior: 不是所有平台的默认工具；平台、编码与进程行为以实现为准。

features.title: 上下文压缩与分支摘要
features.purpose: 把长历史压缩为摘要，控制下一次请求的上下文规模。
features.behavior: 摘要影响上下文投影，不直接等价于删除原始会话历史。

features.title: 会话树、分叉与克隆
features.purpose: 从历史位置继续，或复制历史创建独立会话。
features.behavior: 区分同文件内的分支和新会话副本；分支敏感扩展状态需要重新恢复。

features.title: 提示缓存预热与用量统计
features.purpose: 管理适用模型的空闲缓存预热并统计请求用量。
features.behavior: 缓存保留时间取决于模型声明；不能把预热当成所有提供商都有的保证。

features.title: 会话导入、导出与分享
features.purpose: 将会话转为 JSONL 或可阅读 HTML，并支撑会话分享流程。
features.behavior: 导出是格式转换；shareDestination 可选 auto/gist/radius，auto 优先可用 Radius，否则使用 GitHub secret gist。上传需要对应认证。

features.title: 选择器、消息与工具 UI 组件
features.purpose: 提供模型/会话/设置选择与不同消息、工具结果的呈现。
features.behavior: 组件清单按源码保留，可从符号和原始注释追踪每个组件。

features.title: 主题、颜色与代码高亮
features.purpose: 加载主题定义并为终端文本、Markdown 与代码提供样式。
features.behavior: 样式属于呈现层；主题资源有独立验证与重载机制。

features.title: 系统主题与终端调色板
features.purpose: 默认从终端调色板派生颜色，并支持独立主题切换与重载。
features.behavior: 主题改变显示颜色；终端能力和调色板读取决定最终效果。

features.title: Radius 登录与 MCP 一步配置
features.purpose: 在登录菜单中提供 Radius 认证，并在完成登录后引导配置其 MCP 服务。
features.behavior: 模型凭据与 MCP 连接属于不同对象，服务采用提供商认证配置复用 token。

features.title: 模型目录刷新与搜索界面
features.purpose: 读取更新目录并在模型选择界面中查找可用模型，维护本地目录与提供商声明的组合。
features.behavior: 目录记录不保证认证有效；查找与刷新和实际发出模型请求分开。

features.title: 网络代理、归因与连接管理
features.purpose: 集中处理请求的代理、连接超时与提供商归因等配置。
features.behavior: 这些是请求基础设施，离线文档不会触发这些网络操作。

features.title: 诊断、错误记录与问题报告
features.purpose: 收集诊断信息、启动耗时与问题报告内容。
features.behavior: 诊断数据可能含运行上下文；报告上传与本地记录分别处理。

features.title: 源码解析器与历史实验资料
features.purpose: 将工作区包导入解析到当前 TypeScript 源码，供本地运行和断点调试。
features.behavior: 实验 CLI 与服务栈已移除；experimental 中遗留中文 README 是历史资料，不能作为可运行应用入口。

features.title: 终端程序状态与取消结果
features.purpose: 向支持 OSC 7501 的终端报告工作、等待交互、完成或失败；agent_settled 的 aborted 区分取消与完成。
features.behavior: 状态协议依赖终端能力；会话最终通知仍在自动重试与压缩处理之后。

features.title: 默认工具的增减选择
features.purpose: 在默认工具集合上添加或排除指定工具，例如 -t +codemode,-write。
features.behavior: 恢复会话先沿用已保存的活动工具，再应用 CLI 增减项；明确替换或 --no-tools 可覆盖。最终工具仍受排除与暴露约束。

features.title: 配置与主题 Schema 校验
features.purpose: 用显式 Schema 校验设置、快捷键与主题。主题拒绝顶层和 colors/export 内未知属性。
features.behavior: 旧主题的自定义颜色应放 vars，更新 $schema 路径并清理不支持的元数据。

features.title: 摘要输出预算与触发阈值分离
features.purpose: 摘要使用模型输出上限，避免推理消耗固定上限导致摘要失败。
features.behavior: reserveTokens 控制压缩触发，不能继续当作摘要输出 token 上限。

features.title: 工具选择、包装、截断与修改队列
features.purpose: 把工具定义适配为执行对象，并统一路径、文件修改与输出限制。
features.behavior: 白名单、禁用与扩展工具注册是不同阶段；修改队列包住完整读改写。

features.title: core · 支撑实现
features.purpose: 编码智能体 · 产品能力的 core 文件尚未单独作语义解读，在此按实现目录完整列出。

features.title: 消息、工具与多轮循环
features.purpose: 维护内存消息、工具批次、steering/follow-up、模型上下文变换与取消。
features.behavior: 当前 Agent 是内存运行循环；持久 Harness 在 pi-durable，CLI 会话由 coding-agent 管理。

features.title: 独立工具管线与前后 Hook
features.purpose: 让宿主通过 runToolCall 复用参数校验、beforeToolCall、执行及 afterToolCall。
features.behavior: 适合嵌套调用；宿主直接调用 tool.execute 会跳过此管线。

features.title: 代理流与状态事件
features.purpose: 将代理返回的响应流映射为 Agent 使用的事件与消息。
features.behavior: 是否使用由宿主注入的流函数决定。

features.title: 根入口与类型 · 支撑实现
features.purpose: Agent · 消息与工具执行的 root 文件尚未单独作语义解读，在此按实现目录完整列出。
features.behavior: 目录归属是索引依据；具体作用请结合原始注释、完整实现与双向引用阅读。

features.title: 统一消息、模型与工具契约
features.purpose: 定义统一请求/响应、模型能力和工具调用数据。
features.behavior: 根入口保持核心能力；具体提供商通过子路径接入。

features.title: 模型目录、缓存与生成数据
features.purpose: 组织模型元数据与目录存储。
features.behavior: 自动生成数据列为资源，不能把每个模型记录当成独立执行功能。

features.title: 凭据存储、解析与 OAuth
features.purpose: 统一凭据来源、登录流程与刷新。
features.entry: 认证上下文 / OAuth 子路径
features.behavior: 认证策略随提供商而异；平台差异通过入口隔离。

features.title: 按凭据个性化 OpenRouter 模型目录
features.purpose: 读取 /models/user，按当前 key 可用模型过滤聊天目录并更新上下文、输出上限与定价。
features.behavior: 无凭据或 401/403/404 时保留输入目录；其他失败抛错。coding-agent 的 ModelRuntime.create 用 withPersonalizedCatalog 接入此函数。

features.title: OpenAI ChatGPT 登录与 OAuth 回调
features.purpose: 让 OpenAI 提供商使用 ChatGPT 登录凭据，并支持浏览器回调处理。
features.behavior: 认证方法选择与模型服务不同；deviceId 和凭据由产品层配置存储。

features.title: 远端浏览器与复制代码登录
features.purpose: 在浏览器不运行于 Pi 所在机器时处理复制代码/回调的授权流程。
features.behavior: 这是认证交互路径，不改变模型消息与工具契约。

features.title: Anthropic 工作负载联合身份
features.purpose: 从提供商支持的环境配置解析身份认证，可使用 API key、OAuth 或联合身份路径。
features.behavior: 是否可用由所选提供商声明与实际凭据决定；文档快照不读取用户认证文件。

features.title: 模型协议适配与惰性加载
features.purpose: 把统一请求映射到各模型协议，再规范化流式结果。
features.behavior: 包含 OpenAI、Anthropic、Google、Bedrock、Mistral、分类/图像等适配；具体清单由文件索引列出。

features.title: Anthropic 严格工具 Schema 适配
features.purpose: 转换统一消息与工具定义，区分支持 strict 的参数 schema，并处理提供商流式结果。
features.behavior: strict 能力取决于 schema 关键词及提供商契约；工具参数最终仍经执行层校验。

features.title: 类型化分类问题、评分与选择
features.purpose: 对 JSON state 提 choice/score/bool 问题，返回答案、概率或评分，而非聊天文本。
features.behavior: 具体可选 ID、支持协议与认证由模型目录和提供商决定。

features.title: 图片模型与注册表
features.purpose: 提供图像生成相关模型与 API 注册机制。
features.behavior: 不等同于对话中的图片输入；两条路径分别有契约。

features.title: 流事件、校验、重试与转录工具
features.purpose: 支持增量 JSON、工具参数验证、消息转换、重试、取消和溢出判断。
features.entry: 工具函数 / Provider 实现
features.behavior: 具体函数、参数与注释由 AST 提取，避免依名字猜契约。

features.title: 兼容入口与 API 别名
features.purpose: 提供旧调用形态与兼容入口。
features.behavior: 兼容层是否使用取决于调用者；与无副作用根入口区分。

features.title: AI 命令行入口
features.purpose: 提供 AI 包的命令行入口。
features.behavior: 与 coding-agent 的 pi 产品入口分开。

features.title: 客户端身份、User-Agent 与归因
features.purpose: 为请求设置客户端身份，统一 User-Agent 与提供商归因头。
features.behavior: 调用级身份覆盖默认值；认证凭据与客户端归因是不同机制。CLI 已通过 pi-ai 传递身份。

features.title: 模型请求与轮询的显式遥测
features.purpose: 提供 AI_TELEMETRY_SCHEMA 与 request/poll span、首事件、用量和指标。
features.behavior: 已替代 telemetryContext，无兼容别名；取消标记与 provider_error 分开，未知费用不推算。

features.purpose: 通过 xiaomi-token-plan-sgp 工厂提供模型目录、请求派发或认证组合；具体导出与原始注释见下方。
features.behavior: 返回 Provider 的导出函数由语法树识别；不根据厂商名称推断支持全部模型或所有输入类型。

features.title: xiaomi · 提供商接入
features.purpose: 通过 xiaomi 工厂提供模型目录、请求派发或认证组合；具体导出与原始注释见下方。
features.behavior: 返回 Provider 的导出函数由语法树识别；不根据厂商名称推断支持全部模型或所有输入类型。

features.title: zai-coding-cn · 提供商接入
features.purpose: 通过 zai-coding-cn 工厂提供模型目录、请求派发或认证组合；具体导出与原始注释见下方。
features.behavior: 返回 Provider 的导出函数由语法树识别；不根据厂商名称推断支持全部模型或所有输入类型。

features.title: zai · 提供商接入
features.purpose: 通过 zai 工厂提供模型目录、请求派发或认证组合；具体导出与原始注释见下方。
features.behavior: 返回 Provider 的导出函数由语法树识别；不根据厂商名称推断支持全部模型或所有输入类型。

features.title: 根入口与类型 · 支撑实现
features.purpose: AI · 模型与提供商的 root 文件尚未单独作语义解读，在此按实现目录完整列出。
features.behavior: 目录归属是索引依据；具体作用请结合原始注释、完整实现与双向引用阅读。

features.title: providers · 支撑实现
features.purpose: AI · 模型与提供商的 providers 文件尚未单独作语义解读，在此按实现目录完整列出。
features.behavior: 目录归属是索引依据；具体作用请结合原始注释、完整实现与双向引用阅读。

features.title: 脚本格式、选项行与语法契约
features.purpose: 解析原始脚本和首行 @options，保留行号，并提供支持语法约束模型的 Lark grammar。
features.behavior: 解析器不自行执行 timeout/output 选项；宿主决定策略。

features.title: 工具 TypeScript 声明与标识符映射
features.purpose: 从 JSON Schema 生成模型可读工具声明，规范化工具与命名空间标识符。
features.behavior: 声明不是运行时参数校验；递归或远程 schema 引用降为 unknown。

features.title: WASM 编译缓存与打包宿主接入
features.purpose: 加载缓存 QuickJS wasm，允许打包宿主显式传入 wasm 与 Worker 位置。
features.behavior: 包资源路径不一定存在于单文件可执行程序，打包宿主需提供相应入口。

features.title: 沙箱宿主、工具桥接与截止时间
features.purpose: 每次 execute 创建 Worker 和独立 VM，向宿主转发工具消息并管理取消、超时与关闭。
features.behavior: 脚本错误以结果返回；未等待工具在结束时取消，外部操作副作用不自动回滚。

features.title: 确定性启动与有序响应投递
features.purpose: 以固定起始时间、随机种子和 UTC 环境启动脚本，由宿主按顺序投递工具结果。
features.behavior: 响应序号从 1 连续递增，虚拟时间单调；恢复要求相同代码指纹。库只提供执行契约，持久日志由 Durable 管理。

features.title: QuickJS Worker 与能力隔离
features.purpose: 在 WebAssembly 的 QuickJS 实例内执行 async 函数体，注册工具与输出、存储 globals。
features.behavior: 脚本没有 Node、fetch、模块或 timer；宿主注入函数是外部能力边界。

features.title: JSON Store 复制与容量限制
features.purpose: 为脚本提供同步 store/load 与 JSON 值副本，成功结果报告 set/delete 写入。
features.behavior: 库不持久化 store；宿主负责保存，失败执行不提交 storeWrites。

features.title: 文本图像输出、调用状态与错误分类
features.purpose: 收集 text、image、console、return，记录工具完成/错误/取消及脚本失败原因。
features.behavior: 仅支持 base64 图像，存在总输出大小和条数限制；图像落盘由 coding-agent 产品层实现。

features.title: 可移植、同线程与远程沙箱
features.purpose: 用统一 CodemodeSandboxBase 契约支持 Node Worker、同线程 VM 与远程 isolate 三种部署方式。
features.behavior: portable 入口无 Node 导入；远程 VM 执行脚本，工具仍在调用者一侧执行；同线程 interruptBudget 限制不等待工具的计算。

features.title: 根入口与类型 · 支撑实现
features.purpose: Codemode · 脚本沙箱的 root 文件尚未单独作语义解读，在此按实现目录完整列出。
features.behavior: 目录归属是索引依据；具体作用请结合原始注释、完整实现与双向引用阅读。

features.title: MCP 握手、请求关联与取消
features.purpose: 提供传输中立客户端，管理 initialize、请求 ID、取消、超时与通知。
features.behavior: 传输负责 I/O，客户端负责协议；不是 MCP 服务端，当前不支持 batch、sampling 与 tasks。

features.title: stdio 进程传输与进程组关闭
features.purpose: 启动本地 MCP 子进程，用标准输入输出交换 JSON-RPC 消息，捕获 stderr 并关闭整组进程。
features.behavior: 停止时先关 stdin，再使用终止与强制终止步骤；command 与 args 分开，不按 shell 字符串执行。

features.title: Streamable HTTP、SSE 流与断点续接
features.purpose: 通过 HTTP POST 和服务端流传输消息，管理 session、重连和 Last-Event-ID 续接。
features.behavior: 使用 Streamable HTTP 协议中的事件流，不等于旧 HTTP+SSE 传输；调用是否重放要按协议/应用边界判断。

features.title: OAuth 资源与授权服务器发现
features.purpose: 读取受保护资源元数据和授权服务器元数据，为授权选择真实端点。
features.behavior: 这是 MCP OAuth 子路径的能力；配置和 issuer 校验需对照实际返回数据。

features.title: OAuth 回环回调与状态校验
features.purpose: 监听本机回调并等待授权结果，核对 state 和预期 issuer。
features.behavior: 回调 URI、端口与 CIMD 路径受配置约束，授权响应不能只取 code 而跳过校验。

features.title: OAuth PKCE、注册、刷新与升级授权
features.purpose: 实现授权码 PKCE、动态注册或 CIMD、共享刷新和 insufficient_scope 的升级授权。
features.behavior: 凭据持久化由注入 StateStore 完成；库不自行打开浏览器或选择保存目录。

features.title: MCP 内容转为模型消息
features.purpose: 把工具结果中的文本、图像和嵌入资源转为 LLM 内容，纯 structuredContent 转成 JSON。
features.behavior: 音频、资源链接与其他二进制返回短占位；Pi 产品层资源工具还有独立临时文件处理。

features.title: 内存传输与协议测试支撑
features.purpose: 在进程内成对交换 MCP 消息，为客户端与适配器验证提供无需网络的传输。
features.behavior: 用于测试与宿主适配，不是生产外部服务器。

features.title: 根入口与类型 · 支撑实现
features.purpose: MCP · 协议客户端与认证的 root 文件尚未单独作语义解读，在此按实现目录完整列出。
features.behavior: 目录归属是索引依据；具体作用请结合原始注释、完整实现与双向引用阅读。

features.title: oauth · 支撑实现
features.purpose: MCP · 协议客户端与认证的 oauth 文件尚未单独作语义解读，在此按实现目录完整列出。
features.behavior: 目录归属是索引依据；具体作用请结合原始注释、完整实现与双向引用阅读。

features.title: 文档、条目、任务与 ID 契约
features.purpose: 定义持久记录类型、文档语义和任务阶段。
features.behavior: 这些记录契约与 CLI JSONL 条目不是同一套 API。

features.title: 会话事务、分叉与观察
features.purpose: 组织持久会话、提交事务、分叉与观察。
features.behavior: 存储事务与观察者通知有专门边界。

features.title: 会话执行、注册表与调度
features.purpose: 组合模型与工具注册、会话配置及任务调度。
features.behavior: 以当前实现为准；设计文档不代表所有计划已经落地。

features.title: 扩展注册、工具覆写与在线替换
features.purpose: 把工具、提示区块、hook、wrapper 与任务定义组成命名扩展，支持同名替换。
features.behavior: 运行中的阶段保留已解析代码，新阶段使用新注册表；会话保存名字而不是代码对象。

features.title: 逐会话模型、工具和工作目录配置
features.purpose: 在 pi.agent 文档保存会话级 agent 选择，继承或修改宿主默认配置。
features.behavior: 请求准备时固定模型和提示；当前 cwd 与扩展在后续工具阶段可重新解析。

features.title: 提示区块、上下文投影与位置化系统条目
features.purpose: 按已选扩展组织 system sections、会话说明、上下文重置与压缩投影。
features.behavior: 提示或工具变化被记录成系统条目；只发变化可保留提供商缓存，历史不会被 reset 物理删除。

features.title: 持久输入队列、幂等提交与撤回
features.purpose: 在忙碌会话中保存 steer、follow-up 和 write，提供可恢复的 Submission 等待/撤回。
features.behavior: 同 requestId 重用原提交；取消等待只取消等待者，不自动终止底层工作。

features.title: 应用自定义输入条目与即时展示写入
features.purpose: 输入可保留应用条目 kind/data，同时向模型投影用户内容；纯展示 write 可在忙碌时直接提交。
features.behavior: 自定义 kind 不可占用 pi.*；带 model、head 或 edits 的写入仍排队到运行边界，排队 reset 也影响写入顺序。

features.title: 持久模型生成、重试与续轮
features.purpose: 将请求意图、流式 partial、模型回答和下一轮工具计划作为任务阶段提交。
features.behavior: 模型调用与可观察状态以提交为边界，重启恢复工作；provider session identity 持久保存。

features.title: 工具任务、重放安全与结果控制
features.purpose: 在执行之前提交工具意图，持久化输出，并运行前后 hook、用量与 terminate/handoff。
features.behavior: 重启只重跑显式安全任务；其他中断调用形成 interrupted 结果，避免重复外部副作用。

features.title: 延迟工具检索与模型工具装载
features.purpose: 以 BM25 检索延迟工具元数据与参数 schema，将命中项加入模型后续请求的工具声明。
features.behavior: 默认最多 8 项；此工具只允许模型调用，且可安全重放。模型声明与工具执行资格分开。

features.title: 持久脚本、日志重放与嵌套工具
features.purpose: 将脚本执行注册为持久工具，先记录外部响应再交付虚拟机，重启时重放日志并重新关联未完成子调用。
features.behavior: 已完成子调用不重复执行；代码指纹、版本或响应顺序不匹配时失败。关闭沙箱不等于确定脚本最终结果。

features.title: 脚本工具声明、按需发现与命名空间
features.purpose: 按命名空间生成脚本可用声明，控制内联预算并提供 searchTools、describeTool 等发现接口。
features.behavior: 默认内联预算 3000 tokens；延迟工具通过查询发现，工具可调用资格与模型直接声明分别管理。

features.title: 持久脚本分类与图像模型
features.purpose: 将模型目录、分类和图像生成接到可恢复的嵌套调用。
features.behavior: 可以禁用模型助手；执行与恢复仍遵循持久任务和提供商契约。

features.title: 脚本结果、调用清单与跨轮存储
features.purpose: 组织脚本、耗时、文本、控制台、图像文件和嵌套调用状态，并维护会话分支中的 store/load。
features.behavior: 完整大文本写临时文件；结构化错误值的返回与抛错由工具 schema 和输出决定。

features.title: 执行环境与输出捕获
features.purpose: 提供文件/进程环境与可截断输出管理。
features.behavior: abort、timeout 与 cleanup 等待所属命令收尾。Windows 使用 IPC supervisor 与 taskkill/MSYS 子树清理；POSIX 使用进程组。执行环境不是操作系统沙箱。

features.title: Durable 编码工具与环境隔离
features.purpose: 提供 read/write/edit/bash/powershell，通过逐调用的 ExecutionEnv 访问文件与进程。
features.behavior: read 支持图像和可选处理器；文件修改按 env.id 与路径串行。bash/powershell 非零退出返回带 exit_code 诊断的错误结果。

features.title: 文件监视、字节解码与大文件扫描
features.purpose: 为执行环境提供可靠监视、分块解码、行扫描、目录分页与字节范围读取。
features.behavior: Windows 监视采用轮询以避免目录句柄阻止重命名；实际平台分支以实现为准。

features.title: 后台压缩、溢出恢复与陈旧摘要处理
features.purpose: 把压缩做成独立任务，允许会话继续，按边界放置摘要并处理过时 cut。
features.behavior: 手动、后台和溢出压缩有不同触发；摘要费用计入用量，旧条目仍保留。

features.title: 阻塞压缩失败与等待环检测
features.purpose: 压缩失败使依赖它的生成停止并公开最近失败；任务调度拒绝形成等待环的等待关系。
features.behavior: 成功摘要清除最近压缩失败；失败期间不继续发送本次模型请求。等待环错误需要修正任务依赖。

features.title: 持久子会话、背景任务与取消传播
features.purpose: 工具在原子提交中创建 task-owned 子会话，由所有权传播终止；背景锚点让子会话独立继续。
features.behavior: 安全重放需复用子会话和 requestId；前台和后台的取消/空闲行为不同。

features.title: 任务所有权、子任务等待与实时任务图
features.purpose: 观察活跃任务状态及 owner/子会话关系，调度 allSettled 或 failFast 等待并收尾。
features.behavior: 后台任务构成取消与空闲边界；任务图显示活跃任务，不替代完整审计历史。

features.title: 提交后结构视图、Watch 与背压
features.purpose: 向 UI 提供会话条目、live、inbox、agent、usage 的提交后快照与逐提交 operations，观察统一使用 Chord Watch。
features.behavior: 状态提交后才对外展示；慢监听超过有界积压后收到最新整份快照。旧 documentState/viewState/taskGraph getter 已移除；退休由显式事件表示。

features.title: 从提交派生 Agent 事件与晚加入快照
features.purpose: 把持久提交转换为 message/tool/compaction 等事件，给已有事件式 UI 接口使用。
features.behavior: 事件由提交派生；超出积压上限用新快照恢复，不能当作无限历史重放流。

features.title: 按模型、工具与会话累计用量
features.purpose: 把生成、压缩、嵌套工具的 token 和费用写入 pi.usage，支持会话和整个 Harness 汇总。
features.behavior: 失败或取消但已有用量的尝试也计入；数值依赖提供商实际报告。

features.title: 内存存储
features.purpose: 提供进程内的记录与事务契约实现。
features.behavior: 内存实现不提供进程退出后的磁盘恢复。

features.title: JSONL 存储与 Node 文件适配
features.purpose: 将持久提交写到文件记录和 sidecar。
features.behavior: 单写入者所有权与 fsync 选项影响耐久性。

features.title: SQLite 存储、迁移与 Node 适配
features.purpose: 用 SQLite 保存持久记录并执行有序 schema 迁移。
features.behavior: 当前 portable SQLite 核心使用 Promise 数据库 facade，事务内必须使用事务句柄。

features.title: 存储一致性用例与基准
features.purpose: 让存储实现复用相同契约测试及读写负载。
features.behavior: 基准是比较基础，不是生产容量保证。

features.title: 持久嵌套调用与结构化输出
features.purpose: executeTool 将子调用记录为调用者拥有的 pi.tool 任务，经过校验、hook、输出限制和重放策略；structuredOutput 给程序调用者使用。
features.behavior: 模型结果使用 output；嵌套调用以 key 重新关联，调用者结束前取消遗留子调用。modelTools 与 callers 分开控制模型声明和调用资格。

features.title: 存储故障与有界缓存
features.purpose: 存储异常使 Session 失败关闭并拒绝后续操作；未被观察的文档按 documentRetentionMs 释放，活跃工作决定调度索引保留范围。
features.behavior: 读取时的 StorageRequestError 或调用方取消只使该次读取失败；commit/mintId 的错误没有此豁免，会使 Session 失败。存储重试由后端负责。文档缓存默认十分钟，0 表示使用后释放，再次访问从存储加载。

features.title: 图像读取与可选 WASM 处理器
features.purpose: read 返回模型支持且符合限制的图像，注入 images 处理器可旋转、转换和缩小图片。
features.behavior: Node loader 在 worker 中处理图像，空闲 30 秒后退出；模型无图像输入能力时返回占位诊断。

features.title: 浏览器 IndexedDB 存储
features.purpose: 在浏览器中持久保存会话、文档、条目与任务。
features.behavior: 与 memory、JSONL、SQLite 共用 Storage 契约；使用前核对浏览器 IndexedDB 可用性。

features.title: 只读 Harness 与存储提交采用
features.purpose: 作为查看器打开其他进程驱动的会话，并约束持久提交与内存状态采用的顺序。
features.behavior: readOnly 不恢复运行任务，拒绝写入和运行；存储持久化后、下次提交前同步调用 adopt(seq) 一次。采用后拒绝会使 Session 失败，不能回滚已采用状态。

features.title: 持久睡眠、宿主时钟与唤醒
features.purpose: 任务结束阶段进入 sleeping，到期从持久 checkpoint 继续；wake/onWake 让宿主决定下次运行。
features.behavior: sleepUntil 替代旧 TaskRuntime.sleep；睡眠不持有 invocation。SQLite schema v2 不能由 1.3.0 或更早版本打开。

features.title: 崩溃循环保护与任务显式重试
features.purpose: 计算未提交新状态的重启次数，到 restartLimit 后停放任务并显示原因。
features.behavior: 默认连续 5 次；正常关闭写回 pending 不计数，新状态提交重置计数。设置 Infinity 才保持无限重启行为。

features.title: 持久任务与提交遥测
features.purpose: 记录接纳、phase、提交、嵌套重放、指标与固定报告字段，显式传播 span。
features.behavior: 遥测不保存提示正文作为常规属性；业务状态仍以持久提交为准。

features.title: 动态模型设置与失败后队列策略
features.purpose: 在使用时读取宿主提供的 models/settings 函数，并按模型覆盖压缩阈值、处理失败后排队输入。
features.behavior: keep/continue/withdraw 控制失败后输入；热替换不等于自动重跑已经失败的任务。

features.title: 根入口与类型 · 支撑实现
features.purpose: Durable · 持久任务与文档的 root 文件尚未单独作语义解读，在此按实现目录完整列出。
features.behavior: 目录归属是索引依据；具体作用请结合原始注释、完整实现与双向引用阅读。

features.title: storage · 支撑实现
features.purpose: Durable · 持久任务与文档的 storage 文件尚未单独作语义解读，在此按实现目录完整列出。
features.behavior: 目录归属是索引依据；具体作用请结合原始注释、完整实现与双向引用阅读。

features.title: SSH 主机信任与 daemon 部署
features.purpose: 发现远端系统、部署按 SHA-256 命名的 daemon，并在启动前校验；也可在首个操作时惰性连接。
features.behavior: 主机指纹由用户带外确认；严格检查应用独立 known-hosts，禁用转发。首次操作失败后由下一操作重新尝试连接。

features.title: 远程文件、命令与连接
features.purpose: 通过分帧 stdio 协议连接远端 Rust daemon，为 Durable 工具提供远程 ExecutionEnv。
features.behavior: 远端执行文件和命令操作，Durable worker、存储与凭据留在本机；错误文本可能与本地环境不同。

features.title: 远端 PTY、窗口大小与前台进程
features.purpose: 通过 daemon 打开交互伪终端，接收原始字节、写入输入、调整尺寸并查询退出与前台程序。
features.behavior: 当前 Windows 不支持 PTY；Linux、macOS、Termux 使用相应平台实现。连接断开或关闭会结束所属程序与会话。

features.title: 根入口与类型 · 支撑实现
features.purpose: Env · 远程执行环境的 root 文件尚未单独作语义解读，在此按实现目录完整列出。
features.behavior: 目录归属是索引依据；具体作用请结合原始注释、完整实现与双向引用阅读。

features.title: 键盘、鼠标与输入缓存
features.purpose: 解析终端输入事件并映射到可配置动作。
features.behavior: 终端协议报告与普通输入需要分开处理。

features.title: 滚轮累计与平台修饰键
features.purpose: 处理高精度滚轮和平台修饰状态，避免小滚轮增量丢失或重复。
features.behavior: 终端协议与平台报告影响可用事件；备用屏 contain 会消耗剩余滚动量，防止边界滚动继续带动主区。

features.title: 路径、斜杠命令与模糊补全
features.purpose: 根据输入生成补全候选与模糊排序。
features.behavior: 补全逻辑与编辑器替换范围共同决定体验。

features.title: 撤销、Kill Ring 与词边界导航
features.purpose: 保存编辑撤销栈、剪切文本环与单词移动边界，供编辑组件复用。
features.behavior: 编辑历史属于输入状态，不等同于 Agent 会话树。

features.title: 布局节点、测量与滚动几何
features.purpose: 按可用列宽和行数测量布局，安排组件及滚动范围。
features.behavior: 终端列宽与文本字符数不同，测量结果服务于屏幕渲染。

features.title: 布局、滚动、输入与选择组件
features.purpose: 提供盒子、横纵布局、编辑器、列表、Markdown、图像和加载指示。
features.behavior: 每种组件的具体属性与方法在符号清单中可查。

features.title: 主屏、替代屏与差分渲染
features.purpose: 将组件行合成为终端输出并管理屏幕模式。
features.behavior: 渲染只处理展示，模型状态由上层传入。

features.title: 全屏搜索与匹配导航
features.purpose: 在全屏终端维护匹配与搜索高亮，支持定位当前渲染内容。
features.behavior: 检索的是终端呈现内容，源码、MCP 工具与会话存储检索属于其他功能。

features.title: Unicode 宽度、ANSI 与 LaTeX
features.purpose: 按终端显示列处理文本、链接、换行和公式。
features.behavior: 字符数量不等于终端列宽。

features.title: 颜色空间、样式与终端色值
features.purpose: 解析和转换颜色，组合文本样式并读取终端颜色。
features.behavior: 终端能力可能影响最终颜色显示。

features.title: 图像协议与能力探测
features.purpose: 处理 Kitty/iTerm2 图像与原生平台能力发现。
features.behavior: 终端不支持时使用对应回退路径。

features.title: 根入口与类型 · 支撑实现
features.purpose: TUI · 终端界面的 root 文件尚未单独作语义解读，在此按实现目录完整列出。
features.behavior: 目录归属是索引依据；具体作用请结合原始注释、完整实现与双向引用阅读。

features.title: Windows 平台桥接
features.purpose: 提供 Windows 原生平台和剪贴板实现及构建。
features.behavior: 二进制预构建仅列入资源清单，不解析为 TypeScript 符号。

features.title: macOS 平台桥接
features.purpose: 提供 macOS 原生平台能力与构建脚本。
features.behavior: Objective-C 代码保留全文，符号不由 TypeScript 解析。

features.title: Linux X11 平台桥接
features.purpose: 提供 Linux X11 剪贴板和工作线程适配。
features.behavior: 可用性取决于实际显示服务与平台条件。

features.title: 原生桥接头文件
features.purpose: 定义原生模块共享接口。
features.behavior: 属于平台实现支撑。

features.title: 契约、变体与方法声明
features.purpose: 以 TypeBox 描述对象输入、状态和方法，区分本地与可远程传输的契约。
features.entry: local / remote / method / opaque / bind / coverage
features.behavior: 契约版本和 schema 参与兼容性检查；principal 变体只限定对象能力，完整认证由宿主负责。

features.title: 宿主、对象创建与根调用
features.purpose: 按类型、规范化输入和 principalKey 定位对象，按需创建并通过 Ref 访问。
features.behavior: createHost 提供 self principal，remote 声明 hostNamed/hostFamily；工厂返回 variant。await get 等待引用 live 且初始状态就绪，root 结束释放该调用持有的对象。

features.title: 状态单元、派生与资源声明
features.purpose: 将可观察 JSON 状态、派生值、监听与资源纳入对象生命周期。
features.behavior: Ref 可跨兼容重载保留；命名 state 按 version/migrate 迁移，派生节点重建，替换来源的监听重新订阅，资源按 version/deps 与独占规则替换。

features.title: 跨进程句柄、连接与 JSON 帧
features.purpose: 通过内存、IPC 或 WebSocket 连接交换对象调用和状态更新。
features.behavior: 断线拒绝未完成调用；不支持连接恢复，断线不证明远端操作尚未执行。

features.title: 代码热重载、迁移与 codeVersion
features.purpose: 准备新实现，在迁移或独占资源需要时阻塞进入，再提交新代码并退休旧版本。
features.behavior: 在途工作沿原 codeVersion 收尾；保留当前与前一个代码版本，cell version/migrate 决定状态迁移。

features.title: 动态注册表与 Facet 装配
features.purpose: 组合对象提供者与可观察注册项，Facet 的 setup 向宿主登记能力。
features.behavior: 新版 defineFacet 属于对象运行时；旧 createFacetHost、defineService 接口已移除。

features.title: 子进程宿主、加载器与进程锁
features.purpose: 创建和管理 Node 子宿主，加载 Facet 模块并管理控制与所有权。
features.behavior: Node 专用入口与浏览器可用根入口分离。

features.title: 不可变 delta 与复制状态
features.purpose: 跟踪 JSON 修改、原子发布版本并供 Durable 文档、视图和任务图订阅。
features.behavior: replicatedState 独立于对象宿主；每订阅最多积压 100 份完整值，溢出合并为最新值，不能当成无损审计流。

features.title: 取消上下文与调用数据
features.purpose: 显式传递取消、截止时间和调用范围值。
features.behavior: 调用方负责提供上下文；上下文不是认证系统。

features.title: 严格 JSON 边界与错误契约
features.purpose: 校验和复制 JSON 值，表达 invalid、forbidden 等运行时错误。
features.behavior: 转移所有权后的值不得继续修改；在可变信任边界复制或序列化。

features.title: Watch 句柄、快照与结束原因
features.purpose: 提供共享的 Watch、WatchHandle 与 WatchEnd，实现有界积压、快照恢复和显式结束。
features.behavior: retired 由显式退休帧表示，不从 null 值推断；结束后释放监听者。

features.title: 有界输出与进度节奏
features.purpose: 共享 OutputBuffer、boundOutput 和 Progress，控制流式输出窗口及提交频率。
features.behavior: ProgressClock 可注入 now/setTimer，当前默认 Date.now 和 setTimeout；定时回调再次检查时钟。节奏按提交起点计算，限制输出不代表回滚已经产生的操作。

features.title: 通用 SQLite、迁移与驱动
features.purpose: 提供数据库契约、原子迁移、前缀校验以及 Node / Cloudflare 驱动。
features.behavior: 从 Durable 迁入共享层；Durable 自身存储与 schema 迁移仍在 durable，版本从 1 连续递增。

features.title: 根入口与类型 · 支撑实现
features.purpose: Chord · 对象与热重载的 root 文件尚未单独作语义解读，在此按实现目录完整列出。
features.behavior: 目录归属是索引依据；具体作用请结合原始注释、完整实现与双向引用阅读。

features.title: telemetry-sqlite · 支撑实现
features.purpose: Chord · 对象与热重载的 telemetry-sqlite 文件尚未单独作语义解读，在此按实现目录完整列出。
features.behavior: 目录归属是索引依据；具体作用请结合原始注释、完整实现与双向引用阅读。

features.title: Span、事件与类型化 schema
features.purpose: 定义操作跨度、属性与事件，并从 schema 推导调用类型。
features.behavior: 上下文显式传入，没有全局当前 span 或内置 exporter。

features.title: 空操作与内存参考实现
features.purpose: 提供零记录开销路径和可检查的内存记录器。
features.behavior: 生产导出后端由应用提供适配。

features.title: 遥测适配器一致性验证
features.purpose: 检查第三方遥测适配器是否满足接口契约。
features.behavior: 测试入口不是自动启用的生产监控。

features.purpose: Telemetry · 遥测契约的 root 文件尚未单独作语义解读，在此按实现目录完整列出。
features.behavior: 目录归属是索引依据；具体作用请结合原始注释、完整实现与双向引用阅读。

packages/agent/examples/mcp-codemode/mai.comment:
An Agent with the tools of an MCP server plus a codemode tool that calls them from JavaScript.

  ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=... node packages/agent/examples/mcp-codemode/main.ts \
    npx -y @modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem .

The arguments are the command that starts a stdio MCP server.

symbols.name: toToolName
symbols.signature: function toToolName(prefix: string, name: string): string
symbols.comment: Provider tool names are limited to 64 characters of `[A-Za-z0-9_-]`.

symbols.name: createMcpTools
symbols.signature: export async function createMcpTools(client: McpClient, prefix: string): Promise<AgentTool[]>
symbols.comment:
One `AgentTool` per tool of a connected MCP server, named `<prefix>_<tool>`. Tools with an MCP
output schema declare it as `outputSchema` and return `structuredContent`, which codemode scripts
receive instead of the text.

symbols.name: createNestedToolRunner
symbols.comment:
Run a tool call on behalf of another tool through the agent's pipeline: argument validation and
the agent's `beforeToolCall`/`afterToolCall` hooks apply as for calls the model makes. Calling
`tool.execute()` directly also works when the agent has no hooks.
symbols.output: (name: string, args: unknown, signal: AbortSignal) => Promise<AgentToolCallOutcome>

symbols.name: createCodemodeTool
symbols.comment:
A tool that runs model-written JavaScript in the codemode sandbox, where `tools.<name>(args)`
calls `tools`. Nested results stay out of the model context; only the script's output and
return value come back.
inputs: runTool: (name: string, args: unknown, signal: AbortSignal) => Promise<AgentToolCallOutcome>

packages/agent/examples/mcp-codemode/too.comment:
Adapters that give a pi-agent-core `Agent` MCP tools and a codemode tool, using
`@earendil-works/pi-mcp` and `@earendil-works/pi-codemode`. See main.ts for how they fit together.

symbols.name: AgentEventSink
symbols.signature: export type AgentEventSink = (event: AgentEvent) => Promise<void> | void;

symbols.name: DEFAULT_AGENT_IDENTITY
symbols.comment:
Request identity of agent loops: pi-ai's defaults with provider attribution to pi. `AgentLoopConfig.identity`
overrides it field by field.

symbols.name: agentLoop
symbols.signature:
export function agentLoop(
	prompts: AgentMessage[],
	context: AgentContext,
	config: AgentLoopConfig,
	signal: AbortSignal | undefined,
	streamFn: StreamFn,
): EventStream<AgentEvent, AgentMessage[]>
symbols.comment:
Start an agent loop with a new prompt message.
The prompt is added to the context and events are emitted for it.

symbols.name: agentLoopContinue
symbols.comment:
Continue an agent loop from the current context without adding a new message.
Used for retries - context already has user message or tool results.

**Important:** The last message in context must convert to a `user` or `toolResult` message
via `convertToLlm`. If it doesn't, the LLM provider will reject the request.
This cannot be validated here since `convertToLlm` is only called once per turn.

`context.tools` is what the runtime can execute; the transcript's system messages declare
what the model may call. Before each request the difference becomes `toolsAdded` and
`toolsRemoved` on a system message. When a pending system message exists, its tool fields
are treated as intent and replaced with the delta between the committed transcript and
the executable set, so replay always yields exactly `context.tools`. Otherwise a new
system message is inserted before the first non-system pending message.

symbols.name: ToolExecutionMode
symbols.comment:
Configuration for how tool calls from a single assistant message are executed.

- "sequential": each tool call is prepared, executed, and finalized before the next one starts.
- "parallel": tool calls are prepared sequentially, then allowed tools execute concurrently.
  `tool_execution_end` is emitted in tool completion order after each tool is finalized,
  while tool-result message artifacts are emitted later in assistant source order.

symbols.name: QueueMode
symbols.comment:
Controls how many queued user messages are injected when the agent loop reaches a queue drain point.

- "all": drain and inject every queued message at that point.
- "one-at-a-time": drain and inject only the oldest queued message, leaving the rest queued for later drain points.

symbols.name: AfterToolCallResult
symbols.comment:
Partial override returned from `afterToolCall`.

Merge semantics are field-by-field:
- `content`: if provided, replaces the tool result content array in full
- `details`: if provided, replaces the tool result details value in full
- `isError`: if provided, replaces the tool result error flag
- `usage`: if provided, replaces the tool result usage
- `terminate`: if provided, replaces the early-termination hint
- `structuredContent`: if provided, replaces the structured content. If `content` is provided
  without it, the structured content is dropped, because it may no longer match the content.
  Return it along with `content` to keep it.

Other omitted fields keep the original executed tool result values.
There is no deep merge for `content`, `details`, or `usage`.

Called when the agent has no more tool calls and no steering messages.
If messages are returned, they're added to the context and the agent
continues with another turn.

Use this for follow-up messages that should wait until the agent finishes.

Contract: must not throw or reject. Return [] when no follow-up messages are available.

symbols.name: AgentLoopConfig.toolExecution
symbols.comment:
Tool execution mode.
- "sequential": execute tool calls one by one
- "parallel": preflight tool calls sequentially, then execute allowed tools concurrently;
  emit `tool_execution_end` in tool completion order after each tool is finalized,
  then emit tool-result message artifacts later in assistant source order

Default: "parallel"

symbols.name: AgentLoopConfig.beforeToolCall
symbols.signature: beforeToolCall?: (context: BeforeToolCallContext, signal?: AbortSignal) => Promise<BeforeToolCallResult | undefined>;
symbols.comment:
Called before a tool is executed, after arguments have been validated.

Return `{ block: true }` to prevent execution. The loop emits an error tool result instead.
A blocked result can also set `terminate: true` to participate in the batch early-termination rule.
The hook receives the agent abort signal and is responsible for honoring it.

symbols.name: AgentLoopConfig.afterToolCall
symbols.signature: afterToolCall?: (context: AfterToolCallContext, signal?: AbortSignal) => Promise<AfterToolCallResult | undefined>;
symbols.comment:
Called after a tool finishes executing, before `tool_execution_end` and tool-result message events are emitted.

Return an `AfterToolCallResult` to override parts of the executed tool result:
- `content` replaces the full content array
- `details` replaces the full details payload
- `isError` replaces the error flag
- `usage` replaces the tool result usage
- `terminate` replaces the early-termination hint

Any omitted fields keep their original values. No deep merge is performed.
The hook receives the agent abort signal and is responsible for honoring it.

symbols.name: AnthropicOptions.thinkingEnabled
symbols.comment:
Enable extended thinking.
For adaptive thinking models: the model decides when/how much to think.
For older models: uses budget-based thinking with thinkingBudgetTokens.
Default: undefined (thinking is omitted unless `streamSimple()` maps
a simple reasoning level to this option, or callers set it explicitly).

symbols.name: AnthropicOptions.thinkingBudgetTokens

Ignored for adaptive thinking models.

symbols.name: AnthropicOptions.effort
symbols.comment:
Effort level for adaptive thinking models.
Controls how much thinking Claude allocates:
- "max": Always thinks with no constraints (Opus 4.6 only)
- "xhigh": Highest reasoning level (Opus 4.7+, Fable 5)
- "high": Always thinks, deep reasoning
- "medium": Moderate thinking, may skip for simple queries
- "low": Minimal thinking, skips for simple tasks
Ignored for older models.
Default: omitted unless `streamSimple()` maps a simple reasoning
level to this option.

symbols.name: AnthropicOptions.thinkingDisplay
symbols.comment:
Controls how thinking content is returned in API responses.
- "summarized": Thinking blocks contain summarized thinking text.
- "omitted": Thinking blocks return an empty thinking field; the encrypted
  signature still travels back for multi-turn continuity. Use for faster
  time-to-first-text-token when your UI does not surface thinking.

Note: Anthropic's API default for Claude Opus 4.7 and Claude Mythos Preview
is "omitted". We default to "summarized" here to keep behavior consistent
with older Claude 4 models. Set this explicitly to "omitted" to opt in.
Default: "summarized" when thinking is enabled.

symbols.name: AnthropicOptions.interleavedThinking
symbols.comment:

thinking models. Adaptive thinking models have interleaved thinking built in,
so the header is skipped for them regardless of this setting.
Default: true.

symbols.comment:
The Workers AI binding (`env.AI`), described structurally so this module does not depend on
`@cloudflare/workers-types`.

`fetch` is optional only because the published `Ai` type doesn't declare it yet — every real
binding has it at runtime. `aiGatewayLogId` is here to pin the type to the AI binding: it is
the one member unique to `Ai`, so without it this interface would also accept an `AiGateway`
or any hand-rolled `{ fetch }` object, which is exactly the mistake the runtime check reports
late.

symbols.name: CLOUDFLARE_GATEWAY_BINDING_AUTH_SENTINEL
symbols.comment:
Placeholder value for auth headers on binding-routed requests. API implementations
require an API key or a recognized auth header (`authorization`, `x-api-key`,
`cf-aig-authorization`) before dispatch; binding calls are pre-authenticated, so pass
`cf-aig-authorization: Bearer ${CLOUDFLARE_GATEWAY_BINDING_AUTH_SENTINEL}` to satisfy
the check. The gateway ignores (and strips) `cf-aig-authorization` on binding-routed
requests. Pair it with `Authorization: null` / `x-api-key: null` so the SDKs' placeholder
auth headers never reach the gateway, which would treat a request-supplied auth header as a
BYOK provider key that overrides its stored keys — the same as it would over HTTPS.

symbols.name: createAiBindingFetch

packages/ai/src/api/cloudflare-ai-bindin.comment:
AI Gateway transport over the Workers AI binding.

pi's Cloudflare AI Gateway support speaks HTTPS
(`gateway.ai.cloudflare.com/v1/{account}/{gateway}/{provider}/...`, see `api/cloudflare.ts`),
which needs a Cloudflare API token even when the caller is a Worker in the gateway's own
account.

A Worker avoids that token by talking to the gateway through the AI binding's `fetch`
passthrough (`env.AI.fetch()`), which serves the gateway's provider passthrough at
`https://workers-binding.ai/ai-gateway/gateways/{gateway}/{provider}/{endpoint...}` — the same
shape as the HTTPS URL, minus the account id (the binding channel carries identity). Binding
calls are pre-authenticated in-account and return the provider's native wire format as a
regular (streaming) `Response`, so API implementations behave identically over either
transport.

A model whose `baseUrl` names that route therefore needs no translation: point it there and
pass {@link createAiBindingFetch} as the request `fetch`. Nothing is rewritten, buffered or
re-encoded — method, headers, query string and the body stream go to the binding as they
arrive, so every method, non-JSON body and streaming request body works.

The only thing this module adds over calling `env.AI.fetch()` yourself is a type: `Ai#fetch`
exists at runtime (`workerd/src/cloudflare/internal/ai-api.ts:158`) but
`@cloudflare/workers-types`' `Ai` class does not declare it yet, so calling it directly means
casting the binding at every call site. {@link AiBinding} takes the cast instead — declare
`fetch` optional, check it once at construction — so `env.AI` can be passed as-is. Once
workers-types declares `fetch`, the optional marker and the runtime check both go away.

symbols.name: transport
symbols.comment:
System One models on the Workers AI REST endpoint:
`POST /accounts/{account}/ai/run` with `{ model, input }`. The REST API wraps the model
output in Cloudflare's API envelope. Third-party models such as `typesafe/jev` add a run record:
`{ success, result: { state: "Completed", result: { answers, usage } } }`.
https://developers.cloudflare.com/ai/models/typesafe/jev/
Cloudflare-hosted models such as `@cf/cloudflare/clef` return the output directly:
`{ success, result: { model, answers, usage } }`.
https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers-ai/models/clef/

Clef models take images as an `images` list of data URLs. TypeSafe's models take them as
System One `assets`, without TypeSafe's opt-in header. The catalog sets `compat.imageInput`;
the model ID check only covers models without it.

symbols.name: isThinkingPart
symbols.comment:
Determines whether a streamed Gemini `Part` should be treated as "thinking".

Protocol note (Gemini / Vertex AI thought signatures):
- `thought: true` is the definitive marker for thinking content (thought summaries).
- `thoughtSignature` is an encrypted representation of the model's internal thought process
  used to preserve reasoning context across multi-turn interactions.
- `thoughtSignature` can appear on ANY part type (text, functionCall, etc.) - it does NOT
  indicate the part itself is thinking content.
- For non-functionCall responses, the signature appears on the last part for context replay.
- When persisting/replaying model outputs, signature-bearing parts must be preserved as-is;
  do not merge/move signatures across parts.

See: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/thought-signatures

a signature from being overwritten with `undefined` within the same streamed block.

symbols.name: LABEL
symbols.comment:
Classification with a chat model served by llama.cpp's `llama-server`.

The model never generates an answer. Each question becomes one chat prompt
that lists the possible answers under single-token labels (letters for a
choice, `Yes`/`No` for a bool, digits for a score). The server evaluates the
prompt and returns the log-probabilities of its most likely next tokens; the
answer is the softmax over the label tokens among them.

Server endpoints used: `/tokenize` (label token IDs), `/apply-template` (the
model's own chat template, thinking disabled) and `/completion` with
`n_predict: 1` and pre-sampling `n_probs`. Pre-sampling log-probabilities are
a softmax over the full vocabulary, unaffected by sampler settings, so the
softmax over the label log-probabilities equals the softmax over the label
logits. The server returns only the top `n_probs` tokens, so a label missing
from the list is retried with a deeper list and then reported as an error.

In router mode every request carries the model ID in its `model` field;
single-model servers ignore it.

symbols.name: MIN_READOUT_DEPTH
symbols.comment: First `n_probs` depth is `max(MIN_READOUT_DEPTH, READOUT_DEPTH_PER_LABEL * labels)`.

symbols.name: READOUT_ESCALATION
symbols.comment: Deeper readouts tried when a label is missing. Only the response size grows.

symbols.name: UNDERFLOW_LOGPROB
symbols.comment: llama-server reports an underflowed probability as the lowest float instead of -Infinity.

symbols.name: LABEL
symbols.comment:
OpenAI's Decisions API: `POST /v1/decisions` with `{ model, input, questions }`.
https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/decisions

The state is sent as JSON text. With images, the input becomes one user message with the state
as `input_text` followed by `input_image` data URLs. Questions map to Decisions types:
`choice` to `choice`, `score` to `score`, and `bool` to `predicate`. Predicates have no
criteria field, so the meanings of true and false are appended to the instructions.

Only OpenAI API keys work: Sign in with ChatGPT tokens are rejected on this route.

symbols.name: ConvertResponsesMessagesOptions.configurationUpdateEffort
symbols.comment:
Effort for the reply being generated. When set, the thinking level is sent as
configuration_update items instead of a changing reasoning.effort, which would invalidate the
prompt cache. Each item sets the effort from that point on: one goes before every earlier
reply with the level recorded on it (`providerThinkingLevel`), and one with this effort goes
at the end. Earlier input therefore never changes. OpenAI documents the item before user
messages only. After tool results it was verified on gpt-6-luna (October 2026) to be accepted
and to apply to the next reply.

symbols.name: getResponsesToolSupport
symbols.comment:
=============================================================================

Message conversion

=============================================================================

How a Responses transport expresses tool changes.

`additional_tools` items accumulate: a later item adds tools and replaces same-name
definitions from earlier items, but it cannot replace a top-level tool and cannot remove any
tool (verified with strict schemas on the OpenAI, Codex, and Copilot backends, October 2026).
Like Codex, every tool is therefore declared in `additional_tools` items, starting with one
at the head of the input, and removals are announced as text. Synthetic tool search can
only add tools. Without mid-conversation system messages there is nothing to anchor.

symbols.name: renderIncrementalToolsNotice
symbols.comment:
Precedes every additional_tools item after the first. Without it, models read the latest item as
the complete tool set once a removal was announced; Codex precedes its incremental tool batches
with the same guidance. Restating the tools that are still unavailable keeps smaller models
(gpt-5.6-luna, gpt-6-luna) from calling them again after later loads (verified October 2026).

packages/ai/src/api/pi-messages.ts.comment:
pi-messages API implementation.

Streams pi's own message protocol directly to a backend: the request is a
single POST of `{ model, context, options }` to `<baseUrl>/messages`, the
response is an SSE stream of serialized assistant-message events plus a
terminal `done`/`error` event. This is the wire protocol spoken by the
Radius gateway, but any backend implementing it can be used, e.g. via a
models.json custom provider with `"api": "pi-messages"`.

packages/ai/src/auth/oauth/meta.ts.comment:
Meta Model API OAuth flow

RFC 8628 device authorization grant against https://auth.meta.com (JSON
responses). Meta splits identity from API access: the resulting identity
token is not accepted for inference, so it is exchanged for a Model API
key via the Muse Code key-mint endpoint (minted keys live about a day).
The identity token is stored as `refresh` and the minted key as `access`,
so the standard OAuth scheduler re-mints the key when it expires with no
bespoke renewal machinery. The identity token itself is not renewable
(auth.meta.com answers grant_type=refresh_token with 404 and issues no
refresh_token), so a 401/403 from mint means the session is dead and the
user must sign in again.

symbols.name: CredentialStore
symbols.comment:
App-owned credential storage, keyed by `Provider.id`, one credential per
provider. `modify` is the only write path, so every mutation is a
serialized read-modify-write; `Models.getAuth()` runs OAuth refresh inside
`modify` so concurrent requests cannot double-refresh a rotated token. The
app persists a credential after login via
`modify(provider.id, async () => credential)`. Login/logout orchestration
is app-owned.

Error semantics: `read` resolves `undefined` for missing entries. Methods
reject only on storage failure; `Models` wraps such rejections in
`ModelsError` with code "auth". Best-effort stores that serve an in-memory
view and record persistence errors internally (like coding-agent's
AuthStorage) are valid implementations.

because correct writes (refresh, login-during-refresh) depend on it;
return the new credential, or undefined to leave the entry unchanged.

store supports it (e.g. a file lock). Resolves with the post-write
credential. Rejections from `fn` propagate.

symbols.comment:
A provider is the concrete runtime unit. It owns id/name/base metadata,
auth methods, model listing, and the operations its models support
(streaming, image generation, classification).

`TApi` lets concrete provider factories declare which chat APIs their models
use (e.g. `openaiProvider(): Provider<"openai-responses" | "openai-completions">`),
giving typed chat model lists to direct factory users. Other model types use
their operation-specific API unions. Inside a `Models` collection providers
are held as `Provider<Api>`.

symbols.name: Provider.auth
symbols.comment:
Required: at least one of `apiKey`/`oauth`. Every provider has auth
semantics — even providers with only ambient credentials (env vars, AWS
profiles, ADC files) and keyless local servers provide `apiKey` auth
whose `resolve()` reports whether the provider is configured.
`Models.getAuth()` returns undefined when the provider is unconfigured.

symbols.name: Provider.getModels

Current known chat models, sync. Static providers return their catalog;
dynamic providers return the list as of the last `refreshModels()` (empty
before the first). Must not throw; `Models` treats a throwing
implementation as having no models.

Current known models of every type, sync, with the same contract as

uses `getModels()`. Model ids are unique within each type; one upstream
model may have separate entries for different operations.

the effective credential. Implementations retain their previous list on failure, publish
persistence and synchronous state changes through `context.publish()`, and honor the
shared abort signal for blocking work.

prices are 0. Prompt-length overrides become request-wide tiers; a rate a tier does not list
keeps the base price. Time-of-day overrides are skipped because ModelCost cannot express them.

symbols.name: personalizeOpenRouterCatalog
symbols.comment:
Restrict an OpenRouter catalog to the chat models the key may use, with the key's limits and
prices from `GET /models/user`. Image and classifier models are returned unchanged. A missing
limit keeps the catalog value. The request uses the provider's configured base URL, so regional
endpoints such as `https://us.openrouter.ai/api/v1` apply their region's filtering. When the
endpoint rejects the key (401/403) or does not exist (404), for example with a proxy configured
in models.json, the catalog is returned unchanged.

symbols.name: ProviderRequestOptions.headers
symbols.comment:
Optional custom HTTP headers to include in API requests.
Merged with provider defaults; caller values override default headers.
On AWS Bedrock these are injected via a Smithy `build`-step middleware so
they are covered by SigV4 signing; reserved headers (`x-amz-*`,
`authorization`, `host`) are silently ignored to preserve SigV4 / bearer auth.
A null value suppresses a provider/API default header with the same name.

symbols.name: ProviderRequestOptions.identity

Absent fields use pi-ai's defaults: a detailed `User-Agent` and no attribution.

symbols.name: ProviderRequestOptions.timeoutMs

For example, OpenAI and Anthropic SDK clients default to 10 minutes.

symbols.name: SystemMessage
symbols.comment:
System instructions and tool declarations at one point in the transcript.

The leading system message is the system prompt. Later system messages change it:
`content` adds instructions from that point on, `sections` replace or remove named
prompt sections, and `toolsAdded`/`toolsRemoved` change the tool set. Replaying
every system message in order yields the current prompt and tools. Providers that
accept system messages mid-conversation send each one in place; other providers
rebuild the leading system message from the replayed state.

symbols.name: AssistantMessageEvent
symbols.comment:
Event protocol for AssistantMessageEventStream.

Successful streams emit `start` before partial updates and terminate with
`done`. A stream may terminate directly with `error` when request setup fails
before generation starts; after `start`, failures also terminate with `error`.
Direct `streamSimple()` calls throw synchronously when request auth is missing.
Updates and `done` must never appear before `start`.

`partial` is the shared live response-so-far helper, not an event-time
snapshot. Text and thinking blocks are empty when their `*_start` event is
emitted and grow only through their corresponding `*_delta` events until the
authoritative `*_end`. Redacted thinking may be complete at start and emit no
deltas. Tool-call arguments at `toolcall_start` are provider-specific;
`toolcall_delta` carries subsequent JSON updates.

symbols.comment:
Shared normalization for provider HTTP error objects.



Endpoints behind a proxy / gateway may return a non-2xx response whose body

the provider SDK cannot fold into `error.message`. The SDK error object still

carries the HTTP status and the raw/parsed body, but under SDK-specific field

names. Provider catch blocks that read only `error.message` therefore drop

the body and surface opaque messages like `"403 status code (no body)"` or

collapse to `"Unknown: UnknownError"`.



`normalizeProviderError` probes the known SDK field shapes (Mistral,

`openai`, `@google/genai`, AWS Bedrock) and returns a struct each provider

composes into its display string. The `messageCarriesBody` flag captures the

Anthropic / `@google/genai` happy path where the SDK already folded the body

into the message, so providers can preserve it without double-printing.

symbols.comment: HTTP status code, when one could be extracted from the SDK error object.

symbols.name: NormalizedProviderError.body
symbols.comment: Raw HTTP body reason, already trimmed and truncated to the cap.

symbols.name: NormalizedProviderError.message
symbols.comment: `error.message`, or `safeJsonStringify(error)` for a non-`Error` throw.

symbols.name: NormalizedProviderError.messageCarriesBody
symbols.comment: True when `message` already contains the body (no separate body to add).

symbols.name: SdkErrorShape
extractStatus
symbols.comment:
Probe the HTTP status, first numeric hit wins, in SDK-field order:
`statusCode` (Mistral) → `status` (`openai`, `@google/genai`) →
`$metadata.httpStatusCode` (Bedrock) → `$response.statusCode` (Bedrock).

symbols.name: extractBody
symbols.comment:
Probe the raw body reason, first usable hit wins, in SDK-field order:
`body` string (Mistral) → `error` parsed JSON body object (`openai` SDK's
`this.error`) → `$response.body` (Bedrock). Empty objects and unread response
streams are treated as no body so they do not surface as `"{}"` or serialized
stream internals. The chosen body is truncated to the cap.

symbols.name: isPlainNonEmptyObject
symbols.comment:
Only a PLAIN object counts as an HTTP body. SDK error fields can hold class
instances instead of parsed bodies — AWS SDK v3's `$response.body` is an
HTTP stream/response wrapper object, and stringifying one produced garbage
like `{"_events":...}` as the "body", which then REPLACED `error.message`
in the composed display string. `error.message` is where the SDK puts the
real deserialized exception text ("Input is too long...", schema validation
details, ...), so the one useful string was discarded for noise. A class
instance yields no body, `messageCarriesBody` stays true, and the real
message survives. Complements the `pipe` sniffing above: web
ReadableStreams (pipeTo/pipeThrough, no `pipe`) and non-stream SDK wrapper
classes fail the prototype check, while parsed JSON bodies (plain objects
by construction) still pass.

symbols.name: OVERFLOW_PATTERNS
symbols.comment:
Regex patterns to detect context overflow errors from different providers.

These patterns match error messages returned when the input exceeds
the model's context window or the provider's request byte-size limit.

Provider-specific patterns (with example error messages):

- Anthropic: "prompt is too long: 213462 tokens > 200000 maximum"
- Anthropic: "413 {\"error\":{\"type\":\"request_too_large\",\"message\":\"Request exceeds the maximum size\"}}"
- OpenAI: "Your input exceeds the context window of this model"
- OpenAI/LiteLLM: "Requested token count exceeds the model's maximum context length of 131072 tokens"
- OpenAI-compatible: "Input length (265330) exceeds model's maximum context length (262144)."
- Google: "The input token count (1196265) exceeds the maximum number of tokens allowed (1048575)"
- xAI: "This model's maximum prompt length is 131072 but the request contains 537812 tokens"
- Groq: "Please reduce the length of the messages or completion"
- OpenRouter: "This endpoint's maximum context length is X tokens. However, you requested about Y tokens"
- OpenRouter/Poolside: "Input length X exceeds the maximum allowed input length of Y tokens."
- Together AI: "The input (X tokens) is longer than the model's context length (Y tokens)."
- llama.cpp: "the request exceeds the available context size, try increasing it"
- LM Studio: "tokens to keep from the initial prompt is greater than the context length"
- GitHub Copilot: "prompt token count of X exceeds the limit of Y"
- GitHub Copilot: 'github-copilot API error (413): {"message":"failed to parse request","code":""}'
- MiniMax: "invalid params, context window exceeds limit"
- Kimi For Coding: "Your request exceeded model token limit: X (requested: Y)"
- DS4: "Prompt has X tokens, but the configured context size is Y tokens"
- Cerebras: "400/413 status code (no body)"
- Mistral: "Prompt contains X tokens ... too large for model with Y maximum context length"
- z.ai: `{"code":"1261","message":"Prompt too long"}`, `{"code":"1261","message":"Prompt exceeds max length"}` (CN endpoint), or silent overflow via usage.input > contextWindow
- Xiaomi MiMo: Truncates input to fill contextWindow exactly, then returns finish_reason "length"
  with output=0 (no room left to generate). Detected via stopReason "length" + zero output +
  input filling the context window.
- DashScope/Qwen: "Range of input length should be [1, X]" (HTTP 400 invalid_parameter_error)
- Ollama: Some deployments truncate silently, others return errors like "prompt too long; exceeded max context length by X tokens"

symbols.name: NON_OVERFLOW_PATTERNS
symbols.comment:
Patterns that indicate non-overflow errors (e.g. rate limiting, server errors).
Error messages matching any of these are excluded from overflow detection
even if they also match an OVERFLOW_PATTERN.

Example: Bedrock formats throttling errors as "ThrottlingException: Too many tokens,
please wait before trying again." which would match the /too many tokens/i overflow
pattern without this exclusion.

symbols.name: isContextOverflow
symbols.signature: export function isContextOverflow(message: AssistantMessage, contextWindow?: number): boolean
symbols.comment:
Check if an assistant message represents a context overflow error.

This handles three cases:
1. Error-based overflow: Most providers return stopReason "error" with a
   specific error message pattern.
2. Silent overflow: Some providers accept overflow requests and return
   successfully. For these, we check if usage.input exceeds the context window.
3. Length-stop overflow: Xiaomi MiMo can return "length" with zero output when
   the input fills the context window.

## Reliability by Provider

**Reliable detection (returns error with detectable message):**
- Anthropic: "prompt is too long: X tokens > Y maximum" or "request_too_large"
- OpenAI (Completions & Responses): "exceeds the context window", "exceeds the model's maximum context length of X tokens", or "exceeds model's maximum context length (X)"
- Google Gemini: "input token count exceeds the maximum"
- xAI (Grok): "maximum prompt length is X but request contains Y"
- Groq: "reduce the length of the messages"
- GitHub Copilot: HTTP 413 "failed to parse request" (request byte-size overflow)
- Cerebras: 400/413 status code (no body)
- Mistral: "Prompt contains X tokens ... too large for model with Y maximum context length"
- OpenRouter (most backends): "maximum context length is X tokens"
- OpenRouter/Poolside: "Input length X exceeds the maximum allowed input length of Y tokens."
- Together AI: "The input (X tokens) is longer than the model's context length (Y tokens)."
- llama.cpp: "exceeds the available context size"
- LM Studio: "greater than the context length"
- Kimi For Coding: "exceeded model token limit: X (requested: Y)"
- DS4: "Prompt has X tokens, but the configured context size is Y tokens"
- DashScope/Qwen: "Range of input length should be [1, X]"
- z.ai: "Prompt too long"

**Unreliable detection:**
- z.ai: Sometimes accepts overflow silently (detectable via usage.input > contextWindow),
  sometimes returns rate limit errors. Pass contextWindow param to detect silent overflow.
- Xiaomi MiMo: Truncates input to fit contextWindow then returns stopReason "length" with
  output=0. Pass contextWindow param to detect via the "filled context + zero output" signal.
- Ollama: May truncate input silently for some setups, but may also return explicit
  overflow errors that match the patterns above. Silent truncation still cannot be
  detected here because we do not know the expected token count.

## Custom Providers

If you've added custom models via settings.json, this function may not detect
overflow errors from those providers. To add support:

1. Send a request that exceeds the model's context window
2. Check the errorMessage in the response
3. Create a regex pattern that matches the error
4. The pattern should be added to OVERFLOW_PATTERNS in this file, or
   check the errorMessage yourself before calling this function

@param message - The assistant message to check
@param contextWindow - Optional context window size for detecting silent overflow (z.ai)
@returns true if the message indicates a context overflow

symbols.comment:

their backoff sleep interruptible. Their built-in retry timers ignore the

here so the classifier and the policy-driven retry loop live together and stay reusable
by the SDK and other callers.

symbols.name: retryAssistantCall
symbols.comment:
Run a single assistant-producing call with bounded retry on transient errors.

Behavior:
- A successful response is returned immediately. Aborts are terminal and never
  retried, but reported as unsuccessful if they happen after a retry was scheduled.
  Aborts during the backoff sleep are normalized to an aborted `AssistantMessage`
  too, so callers do not need to care when cancellation happened.
- A non-retryable error (per {@link isRetryableAssistantError}, including quota/
  billing exhaustion) is returned immediately so deterministic errors fail fast.
- Otherwise retries up to `maxRetries` times with exponential backoff, emitting
  `onRetryScheduled` before each sleep, `onRetryAttemptStart` after each sleep before
  the retried call starts, and `onRetryFinished` once at the end (whether the loop
  ends in success, exhausted retries, or an aborted backoff).

When `policy` is undefined or disabled, the first response is returned unchanged
(equivalent to calling `produce()` directly).

symbols.name: isRetryableAssistantError
symbols.comment:
Classifies whether a failed assistant message looks like a transient provider
or transport error, so callers can decide if the last assistant turn should be
restarted.

This does not implement retry policy. Callers should first handle context
overflow separately, then apply their own retry budget, backoff, and reporting
before restarting the assistant turn.

symbols.name: sanitizeSurrogates
symbols.comment:
Removes unpaired Unicode surrogate characters from a string.

Unpaired surrogates (high surrogates 0xD800-0xDBFF without matching low surrogates 0xDC00-0xDFFF,
or vice versa) cause JSON serialization errors in many API providers.

Valid emoji and other characters outside the Basic Multilingual Plane use properly paired
surrogates and will NOT be affected by this function.

@param text - The text to sanitize
@returns The sanitized text with unpaired surrogates removed

@example
Valid emoji (properly paired surrogates) are preserved
sanitizeSurrogates("Hello 🙈 World") // => "Hello 🙈 World"

Unpaired high surrogate is removed
const unpaired = String.fromCharCode(0xD83D); // high surrogate without low
sanitizeSurrogates(`Text ${unpaired} here`) // => "Text  here"

symbols.name: TranscriptToolSupport
symbols.comment:
How a transport can express tool changes after the first request.

- `"none"`: only the top-level tool list exists; it always holds the current tools.
- `"additions"`: tools can be added at a later message, but not removed or redefined.
- `"changes"`: every tool, including the initial ones, is declared in place, and a later
  declaration under the same name replaces the earlier one. Removals are not expressible on
  the wire, so the transport announces them as text and the removed tools stay declared.

symbols.name: TranscriptTools.requestTools

symbols.name: resolveTranscriptTools
symbols.signature: export function resolveTranscriptTools(messages: TranscriptMessages, support: TranscriptToolSupport): TranscriptTools
symbols.comment:
Split tool declarations between the top-level request field and in-place changes.

With `"changes"`, the top-level list stays empty and every system message, including the
leading one, declares its tools in place: an in-place declaration can replace an earlier
in-place one, but not a top-level one. With `"additions"`, a removal or redefinition cannot be
expressed in place, so the top-level list becomes the tool state after the last such change;
later additions stay anchored, and the cached prefix is invalidated once per removal instead
of on every later addition. With `"none"`, the top-level list is the current tool set.

symbols.name: Connection
symbols.comment:
─── connection ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

One end of a link on a host: consumer of remote references, provider for the peer's holds, and relay.

State
-----

A hold implies the state of its variant (unless it says `state: false`). The provider answers with a unit: the shape,
then a snapshot of each state member the consumer does not have yet (`shape.state` lists them), then the members'
ops and resets. A reload or a variant change sends another unit with the members that are new; members that left the
variant stop. The consumer applies a shape once its snapshots are here (`RemoteBinding`).

Flow control
------------

Problem: state is pushed as fast as it changes, but a peer may read slowly (a phone behind a relay), and a relay may
hide that: Cloudflare forwards to browsers without backpressure. Everything sent then queues in front of the next
call result. Example: a browser opens three long transcripts (500 KiB of snapshots each) over a 5 Mbit/s path; a
result sent next waits 2.4 s, and the snapshot of a transcript the user already left is still sent in full.

Solution: the peer acknowledges what it processed (`ack`, a cumulative frame count), and the sender counts the sizes
of the frames not yet acknowledged. While they exceed the window, state waits here in slots, flushed in creation
order as acknowledgements come:
- a member's stream has one slot: ops are appended (encoded batches of one stream may be concatenated, see
  `encoder`), a snapshot, reset or error replaces it;
- a hold's unit has one slot, built lazily from the current values when it is sent, so a newer unit merges into it;
  while it waits, the members it introduces have no stream yet.

The first unit of a hold that is not a re-hold (`again`) is sent at once, past the window: a `get` waits for it, and
must not wait behind other holds' state. Results, shapes, gone, reload control and pings are sent at once too: they
are bounded by the requests the peer makes. Hence the one ordering exception of a link: while state waits, a result
can arrive before state changes made before it. Frames of one stream stay in order.

Waiting ops are capped per link (`pendingCap`): beyond, the oldest streams are replaced by their current value (a
reset built at flush), or, on a relay, by a reset asked of the provider (`resync`), so memory stays bounded however
long the peer stalls. The window bounds what is unacknowledged when a frame is sent, so one frame (a large snapshot)
may exceed it. Both hellos must announce `acks`; with an older peer nothing is acknowledged and nothing waits. Links
that do not report sizes (IPC) never fill the window.

Tuples are the form — in memory, on the wire, on disk.

`r` is the ONLY op that replaces a whole value. `s`/`d`/`a`/`t` cannot target
the root: the type forbids it. `p` and `m` may, because a tracked value can
itself be an array. Operation shape is not canonical: an array may be emptied by either
a replacement or a root splice.

`Op` knows nothing about the path dictionary. Interning, id references and
omitted paths live in `WireOp` and exist only between `encode` and `decode`.

symbols.name: RESERVED_SEGMENTS

─── Path safety ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

Segments that reach the prototype chain.

`JSON.parse` is safe on its own — it makes `__proto__` an own property. What is
not safe is `parent[key] = value`, which is exactly what an applier does, and
paths are data: `["s", ["__proto__", "isAdmin"], true]` pollutes
`Object.prototype` for the whole process.

Ops arrive from a facet, a plugin compartment, or a tool whose details may echo
model output, so none of it is trusted input.

symbols.name: assertIndexInRange
symbols.signature: function assertIndexInRange(parent: readonly unknown[], index: number): void
symbols.comment:
An index may address an existing element or append exactly one past the end.

This is not an arbitrary cap — it is what keeps the value a `JsonValue`. A
sparse array does not survive a JSON round trip: holes serialise to `null` and
return as real properties, so `arr[7] = x` on a length-3 array already produces
state a replica cannot match. Rejecting the write is more honest than silently
diverging.

It also removes the denial of service it would otherwise permit:
`["s", ["xs", 4294967290], 1]` allocates a 4.29-billion-entry array from one op.
Growth stays possible and stays proportional — the tracker already emits
`arr.length = n` as a splice of explicit nulls, whose op size grows with the
gap, so a large growth costs a large op rather than a small one.

symbols.name: PACK_THRESHOLD
symbols.comment:
─── payload packing ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────



A transport optimization, invisible above the links. A frame's payload (call args, a result value, a state snapshot)

whose JSON exceeds `PACK_THRESHOLD` characters is sent deflated. A host that only relays the frame forwards the

deflated bytes unread (`Packed`); the host that uses the payload inflates it (`unpack`). Only hosts with Node's zlib

deflate (synchronously, so frames keep their order); a browser inflates with `DecompressionStream` before delivery.

Payloads whose JSON is longer than this many characters are deflated.

symbols.name: queue
symbols.comment:
One FIFO queue for every observer notification (state events, shape pushes, registry tables, listener

invocations).



Problem: notifying observers synchronously from inside a write lets a re-entrant write overtake the write being

published. Example: subscriber A reacts to n = 1 by writing n = 2; subscriber B then sees 2 before 1.

Solution: a publication first adopts every revision it makes (cells and derivations), then enqueues its

notifications. Notifications run in enqueue order, so every observer sees revisions in adoption order.

`holdPublications` defers delivery until a multi-step change (a reload commit) is complete.

symbols.name: enqueue
symbols.comment: Runs `task` after everything enqueued before it. Tasks must not throw (report instead).

symbols.name: holdPublications
symbols.comment: Delivers nothing until `fn` returns, then everything it enqueued, in order.

symbols.comment:
One hold per host and key (type, normalized input, principal key, contract fingerprint), shared by every reference to
it: one hold over the link, one stream per state member, calls over the same hold. References are views onto it.

A hold implies the state of its variant (unless no view wants state): the provider answers with a unit, the shape

here, so a live binding always has every state member of its variant. After the first hydration the values stay

symbols.comment:
Asynchronous SQL operations shared by a database and its transaction handles.

`exec` runs SQL text without bindings and may contain several statements. `run`, `get`, and `all`
execute one statement with positional bindings. Adapters may cache prepared statements by SQL text,
so callers pass values as bindings instead of interpolating them.

symbols.name: SqliteDatabase
symbols.comment:
Minimal portable SQLite database facade.

All operations are asynchronous so adapters may execute outside the caller's runtime.

`transaction` passes the callback a transaction handle. All work in the transaction
must use that handle; the handle is invalid after the callback settles. Adapters must
queue unrelated operations and other transactions until the transaction finishes. The
returned promise settles after commit or rollback. Calling the database itself (including
`transaction` or `close`) from inside a callback therefore waits for that transaction and
never settles.

When the callback rejects, the adapter must roll the transaction back before rejecting
with that same error. If rollback fails, it must reject with a different error (for
example an `AggregateError`) so callers cannot mistake the callback error for a
guaranteed rollback.

symbols.name: PROTOCOL_VERSION
symbols.comment:
JSON frames between two hosts (or a host and a client). Ids are chosen by the side that creates the hold, call or

subscription; every frame type has one direction, so ids never collide:

consumer → provider: hold, release, call, cancel, sub, unsub, resync

provider → consumer: shape, gone, result, state

State is addressed by (hold id, member): a hold implies the state of its variant, sent as units (a shape followed by

a snapshot of each member the consumer lacks; see Connection).

both: hello, ping, pong, bye, root_end, ack; parent → child: invalidate, prepare, commit, abort, retire;

child → parent: vote



Each frame is declared once, as the schema every received frame is checked against (`isFrame`); the types are derived

from it. Payloads (hold inputs, call args, results, snapshots) stay `unknown`: they are validated where they are

used, against the contract. State ops are checked op by op by the delta decoder.

The link protocol version, announced in `hello`. Peers of different versions do not talk: the side that notices
closes the link with reason `protocol-version <its version>`, so the other side learns it too
(`LinkOptions.onProtocolMismatch`).

symbols.signature: export class CodemodeSandboxDurableObject<Env = unknown> extends DurableObject<Env> {
symbols.comment:
The remote end of `RemoteCodemodeSandbox`: a Durable Object whose one RPC method runs a script's
VM and calls back into the client for every tool call.

Deploy it as its own Worker and bind it from the Worker that runs your agent with `script_name`.
A separate Worker is what keeps scripts off the agent's thread: a class in the same Worker can
share an isolate, and therefore a thread, with the objects that call it.

The object keeps no state between executions and never touches storage. Executions that reach
the same instance share its thread: they interleave while they wait on tools, and a script that
computes delays the others. Name instances per session (`getByName(sessionId)`) to keep one
session's scripts together, or per execution for full independence.

Limits apply to every request, whatever the client asks for. Override the fields in a subclass:

    export class CodemodeSandbox extends CodemodeSandboxDurableObject {
      protected maxInterruptBudget = 200_000;
    }

symbols.comment: VM memory per execution; the client may only ask for less.

packages/codemode/src/cloudflare.ts.comment:
Cloudflare Workers entry, for Workers built with Wrangler.

Wrangler's default `CompiledWasm` rule turns the `.wasm` import below into a
`WebAssembly.Module`; Workers cannot compile WebAssembly from bytes at runtime. Other bundlers
do not support the import: use `@earendil-works/pi-codemode/portable` with your own module there.

Two ways to run codemode on Cloudflare:
- `RemoteCodemodeSandbox` with a {@link CodemodeSandboxDurableObject} deployed as its own
  Worker: scripts run in a separate isolate and never block the caller. Use this from a Durable
  Object that serves a session.
- {@link createInlineCodemodeSandbox}: scripts run on the caller's thread. Simplest; a script
  that computes blocks the caller until it awaits a tool or uses up its interrupt budget.

symbols.name: CodemodeSandboxBase.execute
symbols.comment:
`code` is an async function body: `return` and top-level `await` work.
Never rejects for script failures; those come back as `{ ok: false }`.
The script can use `store(key, value)` and `load(key)` on `options.store`.

symbols.name: CodemodeSandboxBase.start
symbols.comment:
Run `code` deterministically, with the caller answering its calls: the same script, start time, seed, tools,
globals, and store, answered with the same results in the same `seq` order, makes the same calls with the same
arguments and produces the same output, on any VM with the same fingerprint. A host can therefore replay it
after a restart. The VM runs in UTC, its clock reads `startedAt` and then the `now` of the result being
processed, its randomness comes from `seed`, and `WeakRef` and `FinalizationRegistry` do not exist.

The sandbox's own tools and globals are not used: the run declares its own, and every call goes to
`options.onCall`. Never rejects for script failures; abort through `options.signal` to end the run with an
error the script cannot catch.

symbols.name: CodemodeSandboxBase.close
symbols.comment: Aborts in-flight executions (they resolve with `kind: "aborted"`) and rejects new ones.
